project.description: Curated source list for the ZoFHub catalog. Games are restricted to publishers that explicitly license iframe embedding (GameDistribution, OnlineGames.io, GameMonetize, HTMLGames). This is the safe-to-embed subset; do not add URLs from CrazyGames / Poki / CoolMath / now.gg / easyfun.gg / cloud.maddox.games or community mirrors (*.github.io, *.gitlab.io, bitbucket.io, *unblocked.org) — those either block framing or violate trademark.

removed_with_reason._comment: Why entries from prior versions were dropped. Read before re-adding anything that looks similar.
removed_with_reason._rule_1_trademark: Any game whose title names a registered IP (Minecraft, Roblox, Brawl Stars, Clash Royale, Among Us, Fortnite, Tetris, Pac-Man, Sonic, Mario, Zelda, Pokémon, Geometry Dash, Subway Surfers, Cookie Clicker, Cuphead, Stumble Guys, Stardew, Genshin, etc.) is excluded — even from 'cloud' / 'fan-made' / 'classic' hosts. Trademark holders sue regardless of host.
removed_with_reason._rule_2_host_blocked: Any game on poki.com, crazygames.com, coolmathgames.com, y8.com, totaljerkface.com (*.tjf), now.gg, easyfun.gg, cloud.maddox.games, google.com/logos, 1v1.lol, shellshock.io is excluded — these block framing via X-Frame-Options.
removed_with_reason._rule_3_mirror: Any *.github.io, *.gitlab.io, bitbucket.io, *unblocked.org, *unblocked.github.io, *unbanned.github.io, snowrider-3d.io, snowrider3d.io is excluded — community mirrors of paid IP, DMCA risk.
removed_with_reason._rule_4_wrong_format: Any URL ending in .git, .tjf, or pointing at a code-hosting page (gitflic.ru, github.com/.../tree/main) is excluded — those aren't iframe-able.
removed_with_reason._rule_5_partial_url: Any embed_url that doesn't start with https:// is excluded — the migrator drops anything that doesn't match /^https?:\/\//.
removed_with_reason.minecraft: Mojang trademark — covers all 'classic', 'cloud', 'eaglercraft' variants. No legal free embed exists.
removed_with_reason.roblox: Roblox Corp trademark + now.gg framing block + Roblox terms forbid third-party hosting.
removed_with_reason.brawl_stars: Supercell trademark — no legal embed; Supercell Fan Content Policy doesn't cover commercial use.
removed_with_reason.geometry_dash: RobTop Games trademark; geodash.org / *unbanned.github.io / cloud.maddox.games all unauthorized.
removed_with_reason.tetris: Tetris LLC heavily enforces; HTMLGames lists 'Tetrix XL' but it's a clone.
removed_with_reason.pac_man: Bandai Namco trademark; the Google Doodle URL doesn't iframe and Google blocks framing.
removed_with_reason.happy_wheels: .tjf is Total Jerkface's proprietary format, not HTML.
removed_with_reason.moto_x3m_poki: MadPuffers' Moto X3M on poki.com blocks framing; motox3m.org is a mirror. (The 'Moto X3M Bike Race' entry above is the legit GameDistribution version — different URL hash.)
removed_with_reason.snow_rider_3d_io: snowrider3d.io AND snowrider-3d.io are unauthorized domains; the legit URL is the GameDistribution one (3b79a8537e...).
removed_with_reason.shell_shockers: Blue Wizard Digital game; shellshock.io blocks framing.
removed_with_reason.retro_bowl: New Star Games trademark; amhooman.github.io is unauthorized.
removed_with_reason.bitlife: Candywriter trademark; bitlifeonline.com is not the official site.
removed_with_reason.slope: Y8 publisher game; *.github.io mirrors are unauthorized.
removed_with_reason.friday_night_funkin: Funkin Crew trademark; no free embed license exists.
removed_with_reason.stack_jump_2: onlinegames.io/games/2025/unity/stack-jump-2/ returns HTTP 403 Forbidden on both HEAD and GET with full browser headers — confirmed dead as of 2026-06-14.
removed_with_reason.tower_blast: onlinegames.io/games/2024/unity3/tower-blast/ returns HTTP 403 Forbidden — confirmed dead as of 2026-06-14.

declined_with_reason._comment: Sections from earlier versions of this file that I will not integrate, with reason.
declined_with_reason.full_web_proxy: The Scramjet / Interstellar / Nebula / Ultraviolet 'Web OS' suite is built to defeat school / parental network filters. Your Ultraviolet stack already handles publisher iframe restrictions (the legitimate use case). I won't add features whose stated purpose is evading network filters set by parents or schools.
declined_with_reason.stealth_code: `about_blank_cloak` and `tab_masquerade` are explicitly for hiding what the user is doing from parents or teachers. Same line as above.
declined_with_reason.monetization_premium_proxy: Selling 'Faster Proxy Servers' premium = monetizing unblocking-as-a-service. That's the business model that gets domains shut down.
declined_with_reason.monetization_vpn_affiliate: VPN affiliate links in a kid-facing arcade is a regulatory headache. Skipped.
